server.notes: The server runs the unchanged src/data.js, src/core.js and src/bot.js in one VM context per room. online/sim.mjs is the step driver that the server, the converter and the tests share.

frame.unit: one map tile; a robot task chooses its own scale
frame.positions: entity centres in tile units; a tile (x, y) spans [x, x+1) x [y, y+1) and its centre is (x + 0.5, y + 0.5)
frame.yaw: atan2(fy, fx): 0 points along +x; positive yaw turns from +x towards +y (clockwise on screen)

level_source: src/data.js (LEVELS); every recording header also holds the map of its shift

cannot: cross the bridge while it is out

frame.pk: kinds of the last 32 presses, newest in bit 0 (1 = work key)

presses.a: work key: actDown(p) (throw, dash, tip out)

recording.replay: tools/convert.mjs rebuilds every step from the seed and the applied inputs and checks every hash

consent.notice: By joining a room you agree that the session is recorded as Stateloop play data. Please do not talk or chat with your partner while you play.
consent.shown: in the online lobby, next to Quick match / Create a room / Play with the bot / Join
consent.platform: players reach the game through the Stateloop play portal (signed in); the server cannot verify that per seat
